description: Use this when the user wants a wishlist or gift registry page that friends and family can claim gifts from, for a birthday, Christmas or another holiday, a baby shower or a wedding. Takes a title, 1 to 80 items (name, optional note, price range text, store name and quantity up to 20) and whether the owner wants to see claims (hidden by default). Publishes a hosted page: friends see what is still available and claim it with their first name. Returns a shared link for friends and a private owner link. Does not accept links in items (name the store instead). Does not buy or track gifts.

name.description: Short item name, e.g. Wool scarf (no links).

note.description: Size, colour or other detail, e.g. Size M, dark green.

quantity.description: How many are wanted, e.g. 2. Default 1.

store.description: Store name instead of a link, e.g. the local bookshop.

note.description: Short note for friends, e.g. Sizes: shirt M, shoes 38. No links.

occasion_date.description: Date of the birthday or holiday as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-12-25.

owner_name.description: First name of the person the gifts are for, e.g. Maya.

show_claims_to_owner.description: true = the owner page shows who claimed what. Default false (claims hidden to keep the surprise).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for claim times, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Default America/New_York.

title.description: List title shown on the page, e.g. Maya's 8th birthday.

name: create_gift_list
title: Create gift list
